study: COMP765 full-video and two-event association rules: fixed ten-seed extension
question: Does expanded training-only mining improve fixed student scores, and do incremental two-event conjunctions add benefit beyond single events?
baseline: Original frozen ResNet50 through layer3, shared448x672 image features, RoI features/geometry/agent embedding and scene GRU256; original distilled checkpoints seeds0–9 selected by supervised development BCE
data: Same64training videos, now ALL annotated frames for full conditions. Pilot32frame mining retained as short controls. Same12development and198officialvalidation videos.

rule_mining.source: ground truth actors in exact training segments only; IDs remapped via master label strings
rule_mining.transaction: target actor and presence of events on other nearby actors
rule_mining.weight: Each target-agent/video contributes total1, divided across its target actor-frames
rule_mining.effect: logit(shrunk conditional probability)-logit(marginal target probability), clipped[-1,1]

inference.context: Original current-frame predictions only, before correction; detector confidence>=0.25; class-agnostic NMS IoU0.5; at most30context candidates; neighbor and overlap filters identical to mining
inference.evidence: max over eligible other actors of q*semantic probability for each agent-compatible antecedent
inference.frequency_control: Same rule effects and denominator but replace per-frame evidence with training marginal antecedent-presence probabilities conditional on target agent
inference.state: Original GRU reset at video boundary, continuous current/past prefixes; postprocessor stateless

selection.source: Frozen pilot selected strength1 for both contextual and frequency corrections; fixed here without new development/AP selection
selection.checkpoint_selection: Unchanged original BCE-selected distilled seeds0–9; no retraining

evaluation.primary: Triplet detector mAP paired contrasts: data scale full_single-short_single; rule complexity full_pair-full_single; total full_pair-baseline
evaluation.tail: Existing training-derived86class standardized log10 frequency; fixed manifest
evaluation.statistics: All10paired seeds0–9, mean/sampleSD,paired deltas and95%paired-t df9; also report original0–2 and added3–9 cohorts separately with df2/6. Intervals conditional on the reused validation set; exploratory multiple contrasts, no multiplicity adjustment.
evaluation.reuse_caveat: Official validation benchmark has prior research use and detector checkpoint selection exposure. This is exploratory, not an untouched test. Student development videos overlap teacher historical development.
evaluation.reuse: Original21condition/seed results reused only after successful three-seed final audit and exact frozen rule/code identity. Additional7baseline results reused only after full-score SHA256 parity with the original distilled runs. All42new corrected-condition AP runs computed.

freeze: Extension protocol and wrapper/source/checkpoint hashes frozen before new seeds3–9 corrected-condition results. Parent rules remain byte-identical and are never remined or retuned.
limitations: Extra ground-truth frames are additional supervision; no student retraining.
Two-event test uses residual conditional effect and deterministic runtime cap; conclusions apply to this specified implementation.
Mining actor-frame transactions are dependent; video support is not a significance test.
Official validation has prior research/detector-selection exposure; exploratory benchmark, not untouched test.
No proof about GRU internal representations.
Ten existing training seeds on one fixed, reused evaluation benchmark; no video-population confidence guarantee.

pair_rules.antecedents: Two distinct nonhierarchical event labels present on eligible other actors; may be same or different other actors. Binary conjunction in mining; min(original per-event evidence) at inference. No corrected-score feedback.
pair_rules.exclusions: Identity/parent-child between either antecedent and consequent and between the two antecedents
pair_rules.weighting_support_smoothing: Identical target-agent/video balancing, joint actor-frame>=5, joint video>=3,5video-equivalent shrinkage toward target marginal
pair_rules.incremental_effect: If shrunk pair conditional exceeds both constituent single conditionals: logit(pair)-logit(max singles). If below both: logit(pair)-logit(min singles). Otherwise zero. Clip[-1,1]. Require abs(effect)>=log(1.1).
pair_rules.cap_scope: Per consequent; rank by joint videos descending, absolute incremental effect descending, then antecedent IDs ascending; training-only selection
pair_rules.combination: Pair correction weighted average with denominator1+sum(pair evidences for nonzero rules). Add to full single delta then clip[-1,1], strength1. Empty pair bank exactly full_single.
pair_rules.frequency: Use target-agent-conditioned training marginal conjunction presence, same pair rule effects and bounded combination as contextual pair condition.

extension.stopping_rule: Complete all7additional checkpoints and all7conditions regardless of results; no significance-based stopping
extension.scientific_changes: Seed count only. Identical rules, strength1, architecture, checkpoints/selection, candidates, frames, score assembly and evaluator.
extension.runtime: Reuse audited original seed0 full-pair adapter and593-frame runtime/replay; architecture/rules unchanged. No new speed claim.
extension.interpretation: User-directed extension after original3outcomes. Combined ten-seed analysis is exploratory, not retrospectively preregistered confirmatory evidence.
